cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that without the prior written consent of each of the Company, the Joint Sponsors and the Overall Coordinators, it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the HDRs it has purchased or any interest in any company or entity holding such HDRs, pursuant to their respective Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries which will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date; frees up on the six-month anniversary; applies to Offer HDRs (Hong Kong Depositary Receipts)
cornerstone.notes: Holders per the table at PDF p.297: Ping An AM, Wanguo, Glencore AG, Mercuria, Trafigura Group, Intera Mining, GF Fund, CNGR, ORIX, Wind Sabre, DAMSIMF. Consent-based wording (requires prior written consent of Company/Joint Sponsors/Overall Coordinators).

controller_6m.notes: No Rule 10.07 controlling-shareholder undertaking exists. This is a Chapter 19C secondary listing of HDRs by an already-listed issuer; PDF p.167 lists that, pursuant to Rule 19C.11, 'certain share repurchase and lock-up requirements under Rules 10.05, 10.06(2)(a) to (c), 10.06(2)(e), 10.06(4), 10.06(5), 10.06A(1), 10.06A(3), 10.06B, 10.07(1), 10.07(2) to (4) and 10.08' do not apply to the Company. The underwriting section (PDF p.344) contains only the Company's six-month Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement undertaking (Six Month Period) — no controlling-shareholder or Selling Shareholder disposal undertaking.

controller_12m.notes: No Rule 10.07(1)(b) control undertaking exists: Rule 10.07 is disapplied under Rule 19C.11 (PDF p.167) and no 12-month control-maintenance undertaking appears anywhere (searched '10.07', 'Undertakings by', 'Single Largest', 'control of the Company').
